title: A burnt psalter
author: Brother Anselm Hobb
notes: Bible 6.1 quest 5 (The Name on the Bones; mw-e39.11): Clatter's psalter, lying among the Forgotten in the Ossuary. Half burnt; the flyleaf has his name in a gardener's hand. Does not quote the hymn (only book-vesperine-hours may). Reading it gives evidence.clatter-psalter, the first piece.

pages.text:
A small psalter, scorched at the edges and gnawed by something. On the flyleaf, in a gardener's careful hand: A. Hobb. His. If found, return to the garden, where the pears are.

Beneath it, in pencil, a later and wobblier line: Do not lend. Corvin never gives it back.
